labels.name: Active tension
labels.function: Generated by actin-myosin cross-bridge formation

labels.name: Passive tension
labels.function: From titin and connective tissue; rises steeply with stretch

labels.name: Total tension
labels.function: Sum of the contractile and elastic components

labels.name: Optimal length
labels.function: Maximal filament overlap: peak cross-bridge number

labels.name: Sarcomere too short
labels.function: Thin filaments overlap and block myosin binding sites

labels.name: Sarcomere overstretched
labels.function: Less filament overlap, so fewer cross-bridges form

labels.name: Vmax
labels.function: Fastest shortening, reached with no load

labels.name: Fmax
labels.function: Load too heavy to move: contraction is purely isometric

labels.name: Muscle spindle
labels.function: Length detector in parallel; drives the knee-jerk reflex

labels.name: Golgi tendon organ
labels.function: Tension detector in series; causes autogenic inhibition

labels.name: Ia afferent
labels.function: Primary ending; one synapse excites the working muscle

labels.name: Group II afferent
labels.function: Secondary ending fiber; reports muscle length

labels.name: Ib afferent
labels.function: Carries tension feedback that relaxes the agonist

labels.name: Alpha motor neuron
labels.function: Contracts force-producing fibers; excited by stretch

labels.name: Gamma motor neuron
labels.function: Keeps intrafusal fibers taut as the muscle shortens

labels.name: Inhibitory interneuron
labels.function: Suppresses the antagonist hamstrings in the knee jerk

labels.name: Extrafusal fibers
labels.function: Force-producing fibers that make up motor units

labels.name: Synaptic vesicle
labels.function: Stores ACh loaded by a proton-gradient transporter

labels.name: Voltage-gated Ca2+ channel
labels.function: Opens on depolarization; influx triggers release

labels.name: SNARE proteins
labels.function: Mediate vesicle fusion; cleaved by botulinum toxin

labels.name: Nicotinic ACh receptor
labels.function: Ligand-gated cation channel; blocked by curare, lost in MG

labels.name: Acetylcholinesterase
labels.function: Ends the signal by hydrolysis; inhibitors cause fasciculations

labels.name: Choline transporter
labels.function: Takes up the breakdown product; blocking it depletes ACh

labels.name: Synaptic cleft
labels.function: Space the transmitter diffuses across

labels.name: Motor end plate
labels.function: Infolded sarcolemma where graded local depolarization arises

labels.name: Voltage-gated Na+ channel
labels.function: Opened once threshold is reached; fires the muscle AP
